sourceDriver: sqlite-wasm-http@1.2.0 registration scaffold with xOpen/xRead replaced by physical chunk adapter; obsolete post-open hook removed
conditions: Fresh context/worker per case; same-origin static immutable 1 MiB gzip9 chunks fetched by sync XHR, ordinary application/octet-stream with no Content-Encoding on chunks; fflate synchronous gunzip; decoded LRU32MiB + compressed LRU8MiB + SQLite cache8MiB; uncontrolled additional browser HTTP cache. Controlled40ms per response +10Mbit/s per response. Length checks only; chunk SHA256 declared but not checked in browser. One complete logical database, no server SQL.
